name: agent-self-evolution
description: MANDATORY after any agent/code-assistant failure or founder correction: file the concrete incident, name the failure CATEGORY, generalize a rule, define an action plan, promote to the holding AGENTS matrix (progressive disclosure), and reconcile across holding repos. Lesson-only closeout is forbidden — it must be category + strategy. Required on every new repository by default.
author: Marcus Vinícius de Lima (holding)

usage.aiAssistants: On ANY agent error, founder correction, false diagnosis, or failed plan path: STOP, run this skill end-to-end before claiming the incident closed. Do not wait for the founder to ask for a postmortem.
usage.engineers: Canonical holding mechanism to turn agent failures into matrix rules and distribute them via APM + AGENTS.md reconcile.
usage.founders: Guarantees that expensive agent mistakes become permanent institutional memory, not one-session regret.
